result.topic_en: Notes on Dirichlet's L-function for the non-principal character mod 4 (the series $\sum (-1)^{(n-1)/2} n^{-s}$): its Euler product, its integral representation via the Gamma function, and evaluation of the integral by residues at the poles of $e^{-x}/(1+e^{-2x})$.
result.transcription:
Reihenbildungen[?].
$\Pi \frac{1}{[-1-\frac{1}{p^s}-]} = \Sigma [-...-] \frac{1}{n^s}$
$\Pi \frac{1}{\left(1-(-1)^{\frac{p-1}{2}}\frac{1}{p^s}\right)} = \Sigma (-1)^{\frac{n-1}{2}} \frac{1}{n^s} = \chi(s)$
$\frac{\Pi(s-1)}{n^s} = \int_0^\infty e^{-nx} x^{s-1} \partial x$
$\Pi(s-1)\chi(s) = \Sigma \int_0^\infty e^{-nx} (-1)^{\frac{n-1}{2}} x^{s-1} \partial x = [-...-] \int \frac{e^{-x}}{1+e^{-2x}} x^{s-1} \partial x = \quad 2\pi i \, \Sigma \frac{e^{-\frac{n}{2}\pi i}}{-2} \left(-\frac{n}{2}\pi i\right)^{s-1}$
$e^{-x} + e^{-5x} + e^{-9x}$ \quad $\frac{e^{-x}-e^{-3x}}{1-e^{-4x}}$ \quad $\frac{e^{-x}}{-2}$[?] $i$ \quad $\frac{e^{x}}{-2} x^{s-1}$[?]
$- e^{-3x}$
$-2x = (2n+1)\pi i$
$\frac{e^{-x}}{1+e^{-2x}}$ \quad $x = -\frac{n}{2}\pi i$
